question: Which of the following muscles regulates the exit of food from the stomach into the small intestine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sphincter**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The muscle that regulates the exit of food from the stomach into the small intestine is called the **Sphincter**.
 
• Specifically, this muscle is known as the **pyloric sphincter**, which acts as a valve to control the flow of partially digested food from the stomach to the small intestine.
